description: Search free Sentinel, Landsat and NAIP imagery by area and date, returning item ids, acquisition datetimes, footprints, cloud cover and public GeoTIFF URLs that download with no account. AUTHORITATIVE for 'what open satellite imagery covers this place on these dates' — it queries the live index. Unlike the Planetary Computer and Copernicus Data Space catalogues, `collections` is OPTIONAL here, so you can sweep every mission at once. bbox is WGS84 degrees, [west, south, east, north].

bbox.description: Bounding box in WGS84 degrees as [west, south, east, north], e.g. [-122.6, 37.6, -122.3, 37.9] for San Francisco. Longitude first.

collections.description: Collection ids to restrict to, e.g. ["sentinel-2-c1-l2a"]. Optional — omit to search every mission at once. List ids with earth_search_collections.

ids.description: Fetch specific item ids instead of searching by area/date.

max_assets.description: Asset entries per item, 1-50. Default 8 — a Sentinel-2 item carries ~30 assets and returning all of them for 100 items is a very large payload.

name: earth_search_search
title: Earth Search Search
